analyzed_vuln.description: Temporary-buffer sizing is not checked for size_t overflow. `ebsize` is computed from attacker-controlled chunk `blocksize` and `typesize`, then `thread_context->tmp_nbytes = (size_t)4 * ebsize` wraps on the 32-bit build. The allocation is consequently much smaller than the four `ebsize` regions assumed when deriving `tmp2`, `tmp3`, and `tmp4`. Bit-unshuffle later writes a full block through one of these invalid/undersized regions, crashing at `bshuf_shuffle_bit_eightelem_sse2` line 445. The root is the unchecked allocation arithmetic and buffer partitioning in `init_thread_context`, not the SIMD write itself.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: A crafted frame must make `get_coffset` call `blosc2_getitem` on a malicious compressed offsets chunk whose otherwise accepted Blosc header requests an enormous block and enables bitshuffle. In this PoV the embedded header has version 2, flags 0x34, typesize 6, nbytes 0x6000000d, and blocksize 0x57000001. Thus `ebsize` is 0x57000019, while four times that wraps a 32-bit `size_t` to 0x5c000064. `blosc_read_header` accepts these values because blocksize is positive and no larger than nbytes; decompression reaches the bitshuffle pipeline, which treats the logical temporary region as blocksize-sized and performs the out-of-bounds 2-byte write.

args: In c-blosc2/blosc/blosc2.c, analyze every allocation/partitioning path for thread_context tmp/tmp2/tmp3/tmp4 buffers, especially init_thread_context, _blosc_getitem, and t_blosc_do_job. What validations and return/error conventions should a root-cause overflow fix use, and are blocksize/typesize guaranteed positive at these points?

The supplied 32-bit ASan reproducer uses a malicious compressed header with blocksize 0x57000001 and typesize 6. init_thread_context computes signed int32_t ebsize = blocksize + typesize * sizeof(int32_t), then size_t tmp_nbytes = 4 * ebsize; on 32-bit this wraps and tmp2/tmp3/tmp4 are partitioned as though the full allocation existed. Bitunshuffle then writes out of bounds. I have observed identical unchecked arithmetic at lines around 2608/2642 in _blosc_getitem and around 2770/2782 in t_blosc_do_job, so the fix likely ought to harden all buffer creation/reallocation sites rather than only the known call path. Please clarify lifecycle/error handling and suitable existing error codes.
